name: CanvasTTY Assistant
description: The Assistant: reviews agents' shell commands and file writes before they run (read-only allow list, a small decision model, a larger second reviewer, then you), triages the task you give a card, and advises orchestrators. Runs on Jev (TypeSafe, OpenRouter, Vercel), Laya, an Eikos server or a model on your Ollama. Off until you turn it on.
description.ru: Помощник: проверяет команды и записи файлов агентов до запуска (белый список чтения, маленькая модель решений, большая модель второго просмотра, потом вы), разбирает задачу окна и советует оркестраторам. Работает на Jev (TypeSafe, OpenRouter, Vercel), Laya, сервере Eikos или модели в вашей Ollama. Выключен, пока вы его не включите.
author: CanvasTTY contributors

services.title: Assistant
services.description: Command review, launch triage and routing advice on a System One model or a local Ollama model.

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Ask the Assistant how to run a task before you spawn a subagent for it: its kind and difficulty, whether it needs a worktree or a container, whether command review will be strict, whether it splits into parallel subagents, and whether the task misses information. Advice only: nothing is started.

task.description: The task text you would give the subagent.

tools.name: review_status
tools.description: How the Assistant's command review runs now (mode, strictness, decision models) and its last decisions on your card and your subagents: what was allowed, declined or sent to the person, and why.

contributions.title: Assistant
contributions.description: Decision models, modes, review strictness and data checks of the Assistant.
